description: Performs a metadata-and-count-only preflight of the official Texas Active Franchise Taxpayers dataset; row acquisition and publication remain default-denied and unimplemented.
redirect_policy: Reject redirects. Permit only exact HTTPS requests to /api/views/9cir-efmm with no query and /resource/9cir-efmm.json with the sole count(*) query; row-returning queries are forbidden.
retry: Retry only transient transport failures, HTTP 429, and HTTP 5xx with bounded backoff. Do not retry redirects, other 4xx responses, host/path/query drift, schema drift, identity drift, missing license status, invalid counts, cancellation, or an absent/incorrect large-acquisition acknowledgement.
checkpoint: Persist an optional immutable preflight receipt containing only validated metadata, exact schema, count, fingerprints, observation time, and explicit not-acquired status. Do not create a dataset release, row snapshot, normalized artifact, or current.json pointer. A future row acquisition requires a fresh preflight and a separate implemented and approved acquisition workflow.
idempotency: The dataset ID, catalog rowsUpdatedAt timestamp, exact 18-field schema fingerprint, and count-only result identify one observed preflight state; the receipt also carries its independent SHA-256 digest.
cancellation: Abort the current metadata or count request cooperatively. Do not start any row request, leave partial receipts, create a release pointer, or publish an artifact after cancellation.
retention_profile: Retain immutable metadata/count preflight receipts. If a future separately authorized row acquisition is implemented, raw records remain internal and normalized record-level records remain local-review-only until explicit rights and privacy review permits broader use.
